cues.en: Hi. I'm Stephen Wolfram, and I'd like to show you a bit about our Wolfram language.
cues.zh: 大家好，我是 Stephen Wolfram，我想向大家展示一下我们的 Wolfram 语言。

cues.en: You know, I've been working towards what's now the Wolfram language for about thirty years, and big parts of it I've been able to incubate in Mathematica and Wolfram Alpha. But it's only in recent times that we finally had what we need to create the whole Wolfram language and to set up mechanisms to deploy it very widely.
cues.zh: 你们知道，我为如今的 Wolfram 语言已经努力了大约三十年，其中很大一部分我能够在 Mathematica 和 Wolfram Alpha 中孵化。但直到最近，我们才终于拥有了创建完整 Wolfram 语言所需的一切，并建立起广泛部署它的机制。

cues.en: We're actually at an incredibly exciting point right now where we're suddenly able to take computation to a whole new level and, in effect, inject sophisticated computation into everything.
cues.zh: 我们现在正处于一个极其激动人心的时刻，突然能够将计算提升到一个全新的水平，实际上就是把精密的计算注入到一切事物中。

cues.en: So what is the Wolfram language?
cues.zh: 那么，Wolfram 语言是什么呢？

cues.en: Well, the first thing to say is that it's a new kind of thing. It's what I call a knowledge based language. It's a language where a vast amount of knowledge about how to do computations
cues.zh: 首先要说的是，它是一种全新的东西。它是我所说的基于知识的语言。在这种语言中，大量关于如何进行运算的知识

cues.en: and about the world is built right into the language.
cues.zh: 以及关于世界的知识都直接内建在语言里。

cues.en: So right within the language, there are primitives for processing images or laying out networks or looking up stock prices or creating interfaces
cues.zh: 所以，在语言内部就有处理图像、布局网络、查询股价或创建界面的原语，

cues.en: or solving optimization problems or whatever.
cues.zh: 或者求解优化问题等等。

cues.en: And through the symbolic structure of the language, they're all set up to work together in a wonderfully coherent way.
cues.zh: 通过语言的符号结构，它们都被设置为以一种极其连贯的方式协同工作。

cues.en: Let me show you. One of the great things about the Wolfram language is that if you want to, you can use it completely interactively,
cues.zh: 让我展示给你看。Wolfram 语言的一大优点是，如果你愿意，你可以完全交互式地使用它，

cues.en: even on the web. So you can type something in and immediately get a result out, like this.
cues.zh: 甚至可以在网页上。你可以输入一些内容，然后立即得到结果，就像这样。

cues.en: Or like this.
cues.zh: 或者像这样。

cues.en: Yes, it's fast. Of course, it knows how to factor that number too.
cues.zh: 是的，很快。当然，它也知道如何分解那个数。

cues.en: It's got all the fancy algorithms built right in.
cues.zh: 所有花哨的算法都内置了。

cues.en: It's also got immediate visualization.
cues.zh: 它还有即时可视化。

cues.en: It also knows right off the bat, like, how to get your friend network from Facebook.
cues.zh: 它一开始就知道，比如，如何从Facebook获取你的好友网络。

cues.en: It lays out the network automatically,
cues.zh: 它会自动布局网络，

cues.en: and it knows all the fancy graph theory algorithms, so you can immediately ask it all kinds of things about the network, like how do your friends break into groups,
cues.zh: 而且它知道所有花哨的图论算法，所以你可以立即问它关于网络的各种问题，比如你的好友如何分组，

cues.en: or what's the most connections any friend has.
cues.zh: 或者哪个好友的连接最多。

cues.en: The Wolfram language knows how to do lots of things,
cues.zh: Wolfram语言知道如何做很多事情，

cues.en: like let's ask it to get the current image from my computer's camera.
cues.zh: 比如让它从我电脑的摄像头获取当前图像。

cues.en: Ah, that's me.
cues.zh: 啊，那是我。

cues.en: Well, let's, like, edge detect me.
cues.zh: 好吧，让我们对我做个边缘检测。

cues.en: I can have it be dynamic too.
cues.zh: 我也可以让它动态化。

cues.en: I can do all kinds of computations.
cues.zh: 我可以做各种计算。

cues.en: Like, there's me broken into little squares,
cues.zh: 比如，我被分成小方块，

cues.en: and there's me with a random color blended into each square,
cues.zh: 还有每个方块混入随机颜色的我，

cues.en: and now reassembled.
cues.zh: 现在重新组装。

cues.en: The Wolfram language doesn't just know about algorithms and computations,
cues.zh: Wolfram语言不仅了解算法和计算，

cues.en: it also knows about the world.
cues.zh: 它也了解世界。

cues.en: Like, let's ask it when the sun will set today.
cues.zh: 比如，问它今天太阳什么时候落山。

cues.en: There's the answer for my current location.
cues.zh: 这是我当前位置的答案。

cues.en: There's the time from sunrise to sunset in days.
cues.zh: 这是从日出到日落的时间，以天为单位。

cues.en: We can convert it to minutes.
cues.zh: 我们可以把它转换成分钟。

cues.en: You know, the Wolfram language has a precise way of talking about everything, When we're dealing with the world at large, we often just want to use natural language to describe what we're talking about.
cues.zh: 你知道，Wolfram语言有一种精确的方式来谈论一切。当我们处理广阔的世界时，我们通常只想用自然语言来描述我们谈论的内容。

cues.en: Thanks to Wolfram Alpha, we built a big stack of technology for doing that.
cues.zh: 得益于 Wolfram Alpha，我们为此搭建了一大套技术。

cues.en: Like, we can just ask for countries in South America,
cues.zh: 比如，我们可以直接问南美洲有哪些国家，

cues.en: and our natural language understanding system can figure out what that means and generate precise Wolfram language code from it so that we get a list of the countries.
cues.zh: 我们的自然语言理解系统能弄懂这句话的意思，并据此生成精确的 Wolfram 语言代码，从而得到国家列表。

cues.en: And now we can compute from that.
cues.zh: 然后我们就能基于这些做计算了。

cues.en: Like, let's generate their flags,
cues.zh: 比如生成它们的国旗，

cues.en: or let's find the dominant colors in those flags,
cues.zh: 或者找出这些国旗的主色调，

cues.en: or let's have a whole little program to make a table of countries in their dominant flag colors.
cues.zh: 或者写个小程序，做一张按国旗主色调排列的国家表格。

cues.en: Okay. Let's try something more ambitious.
cues.zh: 好，我们试个更有野心的。

cues.en: Let's get a list of the capitals of the countries in Western Europe.
cues.zh: 先取西欧各国的首都列表。

cues.en: Now let's find what order we'd have to visit these in to have the shortest tour of all of them.
cues.zh: 再算出按什么顺序走访，才能走遍所有这些城市且路程最短。

cues.en: Needless to say, the orphan language has the best known algorithms for solving a so called travelling salesman problem like that.
cues.zh: 不用说，Wolfram 语言拥有求解这类所谓旅行商问题的最佳已知算法。

cues.en: Now let's plot the tour on a map as a thick red line,
cues.zh: 现在把这条路线在地图上画成一条粗红线，

cues.en: and yes, the Wolfram language has detailed maps of everywhere built in.
cues.zh: 没错，Wolfram 语言内置了各地的详细地图。

cues.en: Okay, well, I've been doing different kinds of examples.
cues.zh: 好了，我一直在举各种不同的例子。

cues.en: There's really a huge amount built into the language. You can get a sense of it here.
cues.zh: 这门语言内置的东西真的非常多，这里可以感受一下。

cues.en: Thousands of algorithmic functions, thousands of domains of data and knowledge,
cues.zh: 数千个算法函数，数千个数据与知识领域，

cues.en: but in a sense that's just the beginning because there's so much more power from being able to put all these things together,
cues.zh: 但从某种意义上说，这只是个开始，因为把这一切组合起来能释放出更大的威力，

cues.en: and what makes that possible is the structure of the Wolfram language and the principles that it's built on.
cues.zh: 而让这一切成为可能的，是 Wolfram 语言的结构以及它所立足的原则。

cues.en: The first really critical thing to understand about the Wolfram language is that it's symbolic.
cues.zh: 理解 Wolfram 语言第一个真正关键的点是：它是符号式的。

cues.en: If you have x, you don't have to give it a value. You can just have it be symbolic x.
cues.zh: 如果你有 x，不必给它赋值。你可以直接让它保持为符号 x。

cues.en: You can type in a formula involving x,
cues.zh: 你可以输入一个包含 x 的公式，

cues.en: and then you can do a computation on the formula symbolically.
cues.zh: 然后对这个公式做符号计算。

cues.en: Of course, this is great for math, but one of the big discoveries of the Wolfram language is that it gives you a way to do a zillion other things too.
cues.zh: 当然，这对数学很棒，但 Wolfram 语言的一大发现是，它也能让你做无数其他事情。

cues.en: Let's say you've got some data with a part you don't know. You can just treat it symbolically.
cues.zh: 假设你有一些数据，其中一部分未知。你可以直接把它当作符号来处理。

cues.en: What about something like a network?
cues.zh: 那像网络这样的东西呢？

cues.en: Well, in the Wolfram language, it's a symbolic expression too that displays as a graph, but you can go ahead and manipulate it symbolically too.
cues.zh: 在 Wolfram 语言里，它也是一个符号表达式，会显示成图，但你也可以直接对它做符号操作。

cues.en: Same with three d graphics.
cues.zh: 3D 图形也一样。

cues.en: Go ahead and create a symbolic form,
cues.zh: 直接创建一个符号形式，

cues.en: render it as three d graphics.
cues.zh: 再把它渲染成 3D 图形。

cues.en: Now because everything is symbolic,
cues.zh: 现在，因为一切都是符号式的，

cues.en: I can just pick up this output and say feed it into an image processing algorithm,
cues.zh: 我可以直接拿起这个输出，说把它喂给图像处理算法，

cues.en: or I can make a table of rotated versions of the image.
cues.zh: 或者我可以做一个表格，包含图像旋转后的各个版本。

cues.en: Something else that's a symbolic expression of the orphan language is a user interface element,
cues.zh: Wolfram 语言里另一种符号表达式是用户界面元素，

cues.en: like a slider.
cues.zh: 比如滑块。

cues.en: I can make a whole grid of them, build up any user interface, all just represented by a symbolic expression.
cues.zh: 我可以做一整网格的滑块，构建任何用户界面，全都用符号表达式表示。

cues.en: Same with documents and document elements too, all just symbolic. And once things are symbolic, it's easy to do meta operations on them, like take a plot and effectively just pick it up and make a dynamic version of it.
cues.zh: 文档和文档元素也一样，全都是符号式的。而且一旦东西是符号式的，对它们做元操作就很容易，比如拿一个绘图，实际上就是把它拿起来，做成动态版本。

cues.en: You can make a dynamic version of anything.
cues.zh: 你可以把任何东西都做成动态版本。

cues.en: And because everything is a symbolic expression,
cues.zh: 而且因为一切都是符号表达式，

cues.en: it all just works.
cues.zh: 所以一切都能直接跑通。

cues.en: You know, any function can be treated symbolically.
cues.zh: 你知道，任何函数都可以按符号方式处理。

cues.en: Here's just f,
cues.zh: 这里就是 f，

cues.en: symbolic f,
cues.zh: 符号化的 f，

cues.en: And actually underneath,
cues.zh: 而实际上在底层，

cues.en: the full form of everything in the language is like this.
cues.zh: 这门语言里所有东西的完整形式都是这样的。

cues.en: Just a bunch of symbolic functions
cues.zh: 就是一堆符号函数

cues.en: representing formulas or datasets or documents or cities or whatever.
cues.zh: 表示公式、数据集、文档、城市，或者随便什么。

cues.en: So what can you do with these symbolic functions?
cues.zh: 那么，你能用这些符号函数做什么呢？

cues.en: Well, one thing is incredibly powerful functional programming.
cues.zh: 其中一件事就是极其强大的函数式编程。

cues.en: Nest a function symbolically,
cues.zh: 以符号方式嵌套一个函数，

cues.en: or put more and more frames around something,
cues.zh: 或者给某个东西套上越来越多的框架，

cues.en: or make a kind of nested interface.
cues.zh: 或者做出一种嵌套接口。

cues.en: Okay. Here's something more ambitious.
cues.zh: 好。下面来点更有野心的。

cues.en: Let's use functional programming to do some web crawling. The Wolfram language already knows how to import lots of things like hyperlinks from my website.
cues.zh: 我们用函数式编程来做点网页抓取。Wolfram 语言已经知道如何从我的网站导入超链接之类的大量内容。

cues.en: It's a little more code, but let's nestedly crawl out a couple of levels then make a graph of what that corner of the web looks like.
cues.zh: 代码会多一点，但我们来嵌套地向外抓取几层，然后画出一张图，看看网络的那个角落长什么样。

cues.en: You know, you can make symbolic pure functions do all sorts of things,
cues.zh: 你知道，你可以让符号纯函数做各种各样的事，

cues.en: like this takes the list of English words that are built into the Wolfram language and creates a function to find which one is nearest to a given word.
cues.zh: 比如这里取用 Wolfram 语言内置的英文单词列表，创建一个函数来找出哪个单词离给定单词最近。

cues.en: Now you can pick up this function and apply it to any word and make a simple spell corrector.
cues.zh: 现在你可以拿起这个函数，把它应用到任何单词上，做一个简单的拼写纠正器。

cues.en: Pure functions and functional programming get in everywhere.
cues.zh: 纯函数和函数式编程无处不在。

cues.en: Here's selecting palindrome words based on a simple symbolic pure function.
cues.zh: 这里基于一个简单的符号纯函数来挑选回文单词。

cues.en: You can generalize this dramatically
cues.zh: 你可以把这大幅泛化

cues.en: and for example, get a shockingly powerful symbolic way to query databases
cues.zh: 比如得到一种强大得惊人的符号化方式来查询数据库

cues.en: and large hierarchical collections of data.
cues.zh: 以及大型层级化的数据集合。

cues.en: In a sense, the Wolfram language is kind of the ultimate fusion language
cues.zh: 某种意义上，Wolfram 语言算是终极的融合语言

cues.en: because its symbolic nature lets it encompass pretty much any style of programming.
cues.zh: 因为它的符号本质让它几乎能涵盖任何编程风格。

cues.en: One that's very powerful and kind of uniquely symbolic is pattern based programming.
cues.zh: 其中非常强大且独特符号化的一种，是基于模式的编程。

cues.en: The idea is you give a pattern for transforming some class of symbolic expressions like this says that anytime there's f of some particular nested list structure,
cues.zh: 思路是给出一个模式来转换某类符号表达式，比如这条表示只要有 f 作用于某个特定嵌套列表结构，

cues.en: here's the value. So now if we give f this kind of structure,
cues.zh: 这里就是对应的值。现在如果我们把这种结构传给 f，

cues.en: it'll produce a result.
cues.zh: 它就会产出结果。

cues.en: But if the pattern doesn't match, it'll just stay symbolic.
cues.zh: 但如果模式不匹配，它就保持符号形式不变。

cues.en: And this is basically how all function definitions in the Wolfram language work.
cues.zh: 这基本上就是 Wolfram 语言里所有函数定义的工作方式。

cues.en: The Wolfram language is a huge language by far the largest ever, but it's built on a small set of powerful principles.
cues.zh: Wolfram 语言是一门庞大的语言，迄今为止最大的，但它建立在少量强大的原则之上。

cues.en: The first is coherence,
cues.zh: 首先是连贯性，

cues.en: the idea that everything in the language must fit together.
cues.zh: 即语言中的一切必须彼此契合。

cues.en: I must say that I've spent a fair fraction of the past thirty years working to make this happen, designing every corner of the language so it's as consistent and unified and integrated as possible, so it's easy to understand,
cues.zh: 我得说，过去三十年里我花了相当大一部分精力来实现这一点，设计语言的每个角落，让它尽可能一致、统一、集成，从而易于理解，

cues.en: and so one can take something from over here and be confident that it'll feed right into something over there.
cues.zh: 这样你就能从这边拿点东西，并确信它能直接接入那边的东西。

cues.en: I've had another principle too,
cues.zh: 我还有另一个原则，

cues.en: maximum automation,
cues.zh: 最大程度的自动化，

cues.en: the idea that the language should take care of as much as possible.
cues.zh: 也就是让语言尽可能多地处理事情。

cues.en: Let's say you're doing machine learning and you want to build a data classifier.
cues.zh: 假设你在做机器学习，想构建一个数据分类器。

cues.en: Well, there are all sorts of methods for doing that, but in the Wolfram language, there's just one super function,
cues.zh: 实现方法有很多种，但在 Wolfram 语言里，只有一个超级函数，

cues.en: classify,
cues.zh: classify，

cues.en: that's packed with meta algorithms to automatically figure out what to do. Of course, if you want, you can go in and control every detail, but otherwise you can just treat it like a black box, one of thousands of super functions in the Wolfram language that effectively give you the highest possible level building blocks for programs.
cues.zh: 它内置了大量元算法，能自动判断该怎么做。当然，如果需要，你也可以深入控制每一个细节，否则完全可以把它当黑盒用——这只是 Wolfram 语言中数千个超级函数之一，它们实际上为你提供了尽可能高层次的程序构建模块。

cues.en: And these building blocks don't just contain algorithms,
cues.zh: 而这些构建模块不仅包含算法，

cues.en: they've got knowledge and data too.
cues.zh: 它们还包含知识和数据。

cues.en: Knowledge about how to import and export hundreds of formats,
cues.zh: 关于如何导入导出数百种格式的知识，

cues.en: knowledge about how to interact with all sorts of external APIs,
cues.zh: 关于如何与各种外部 API 交互的知识，

cues.en: knowledge about how to compute properties of systems in the world and also huge amounts of curated computable data stored in the cloud and continuously updated,
cues.zh: 关于如何计算现实世界系统属性的知识，还有存储在云端、持续更新的大量精选可计算数据，

cues.en: the same data that powers Wolfram Alpha completely programmatically accessible.
cues.zh: 这些数据同样驱动着 Wolfram Alpha，并且完全可以以编程方式访问。

cues.en: But okay, so the Wolfram language makes it really easy to create really powerful programs, but what can you do with them? Well, it turns out that the symbolic nature of the language does something great here too because it lets the language define and describe its own deployment.
cues.zh: 不过话说回来，Wolfram 语言确实让创建强大程序变得非常容易，但你能用它们做什么呢？事实证明，这门语言的符号特性在这方面也大有作为，因为它让语言能够定义和描述自身的部署。

cues.en: Let's say you set up a function in the Wolfram language. You can run it in your notebook session or you can just take the symbolic code and deploy it to the cloud.
cues.zh: 比如说，你在 Wolfram 语言里定义了一个函数。你可以在笔记本会话中运行它，也可以直接把符号代码部署到云端。

cues.en: You can just go to the cloud object from the web,
cues.zh: 你只要从网页访问这个云对象，

cues.en: and if you do, you'll see a web interface,
cues.zh: 就能看到一个网页界面，

cues.en: which automatically runs your Wolfram language code in the cloud.
cues.zh: 它会自动在云端运行你的 Wolfram 语言代码。

cues.en: And by the way, you can set up a mobile app to do the same kind of thing.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，你也可以设置一个移动应用来做类似的事。

cues.en: The interface here uses CDF, our computable document format, running in the cloud.
cues.zh: 这里的界面使用 CDF，也就是我们的可计算文档格式，并在云端运行。

cues.en: And in fact, you can run the whole native notebook interface for the Wolfram language in the cloud. Here it is. You can use notebooks as templates for reports that get filled in by running Wolfram language code. You can schedule Wolfram language code to run on cloud servers at particular times, say, sending you mail, you can take any Wolfram language function and set up an instant API for it that you can call from anywhere on the web, like this asks for a JSON output of some weather data for the user's geolocation.
cues.zh: 实际上，你可以在云端运行完整的 Wolfram 语言原生笔记本界面。就是这个样子。你可以把笔记本用作报告模板，再通过运行 Wolfram 语言代码填入内容。你可以安排 Wolfram 语言代码在指定时间于云服务器上运行，比如给你发邮件；你也可以把任意 Wolfram 语言函数设成即时 API，从网页上的任何地方调用。比如这个例子，会根据用户的地理位置请求天气数据的 JSON 输出。

cues.en: If you have an embedded Wolfram engine, you can get code to embed a call to this in lots of languages,
cues.zh: 如果你有嵌入式 Wolfram 引擎，就可以用很多种语言编写代码，在其中嵌入对它的调用，

cues.en: and you can actually call the code without even going to the web.
cues.zh: 而且实际上，你甚至不用访问网页就能调用这段代码。

cues.en: One thing about the Wolfram language is that it's completely scalable.
cues.zh: Wolfram 语言有一个特点：它完全可以扩展到不同规模。

cues.en: You can write tiny one line programs that are already very powerful, or you can write multimillion line programs like Wolfram Alpha.
cues.zh: 你可以写出功能强大的单行小程序，也可以编写像 Wolfram Alpha 那样拥有数百万行代码的大型程序。

cues.en: It's so much easier to build and debug symbolic programs because at every stage, every piece is meaningful, And depending on your style of programming, there are various IDEs for the Wolfram language that take advantage of the symbolic character of the language.
cues.zh: 构建和调试符号程序要容易得多，因为每个阶段、每个部分都有意义；而且根据你的编程风格，Wolfram 语言有多种 IDE 可以利用这门语言的符号特性。

cues.en: You can use the Wolfram language for high performance computing too. It's got parallelism built right into the language.
cues.zh: 你也可以用 Wolfram 语言做高性能计算。它把并行能力直接内置在语言里。

cues.en: So this is automatically starting up and running lots of different processes across my little heterogeneous network and collecting the results.
cues.zh: 所以它会自动启动，并在我这个小型异构网络上运行许多不同进程，然后收集结果。

cues.en: You can also use the Wolfen language on the upcoming generation of tiny embedded processors.
cues.zh: 你也可以在即将到来的新一代微型嵌入式处理器上使用 Wolfram 语言。

cues.en: For example, it's included with the OS for the Raspberry Pi Linux computer.
cues.zh: 例如，它已经包含在 Raspberry Pi Linux 计算机的操作系统中。

cues.en: You can use the Wolfram language to interact with devices.
cues.zh: 你可以用 Wolfram 语言与设备交互。

cues.en: In fact, the Wolfram language is in a unique position with respect to devices and with respect to real world data in general because in a sense it's a language that has a model of the world built in. And in fact WDF,
cues.zh: 事实上，在设备以及一般现实世界数据方面，Wolfram 语言处于独特位置，因为从某种意义上说，它是一门内置世界模型的语言。而事实上，WDF，

cues.en: the Wolfram data framework, encapsulates that model and within the Wolfram language there are lots of ways of taking unstructured data and getting it into WDF
cues.zh: 即 Wolfram 数据框架，封装了该模型；在 Wolfram 语言中，有很多方法可以把非结构化数据导入 WDF

cues.en: with its units and dates and entities and so on made canonical.
cues.zh: 并将其单位、日期、实体等规范化。

cues.en: When it comes to devices,
cues.zh: 说到设备，

cues.en: the Wolfram Connected Devices project is curating them to make them automatically accessible from within the language.
cues.zh: Wolfram Connected Devices 项目正在整理这些设备，使它们能在语言内部被自动访问。

cues.en: Okay. So I've tried to give some indication of what the Wolfram language is about. So how can you get started?
cues.zh: 好的。我之前大致介绍了 Wolfram 语言是干什么的。那么你怎么上手呢？

cues.en: Like after every output, there's a suggestions bar that suggests what you might want to do next, and you can even try just giving input a natural language and starting to construct your programs that way. And when you've got a program you like, you can deploy it in all sorts of ways.
cues.zh: 比如每个输出后面都有一个建议栏，提示你接下来可能想做什么，你甚至可以直接用自然语言输入，然后就这样开始构建你的程序。当你有了满意的程序，可以用各种方式把它部署出去。

cues.en: My goal with the Wolfram language has been to encapsulate as much computational knowledge as possible, so people can go from ideas to deployed products as quickly and easily as possible.
cues.zh: 我做 Wolfram 语言的目标，就是把尽可能多的计算知识封装起来，让人们能尽可能快速、轻松地从想法走到可部署的产品。

cues.en: I've also been very pleased that the Wolfram language seems to be uniquely good as a first programming language because you can do so much so easily and quickly get exposed to such a broad range of methods and topics.
cues.zh: 我也很高兴，Wolfram 语言似乎特别适合作为第一门编程语言，因为你能轻松做很多事，并很快接触到非常广泛的方法和主题。

cues.en: I've been working towards the Wolfram language for thirty years. We laid strong foundations very early and we've just kept on building.
cues.zh: 我为 Wolfram 语言已经努力了三十年。我们很早就打下了坚实的基础，然后一直在上面不断构建。

cues.en: And actually, I keep on being amazed at what's possible.
cues.zh: 而且说实话，能做到的事情一直让我惊叹。

cues.en: And now we've got a vast stack of technology and content that I think just completely changes how we should think about programming.
cues.zh: 现在我们已经有了庞大的技术和内容栈，我认为它彻底改变了我们该怎样看待编程。

cues.en: I get a big kick out of using it every day. I hope you'll have a chance to try it and that you'll end up doing amazing things with the Wolfram language.
cues.zh: 我每天都用它，从中获得很大乐趣。希望你有机会试一试，并最终用 Wolfram 语言做出了不起的东西。

cues.en: Thanks very much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢。
